headline: Banking maintains good capitalization levels at close of Q3
summary: The banking sector's non-performing loan ratio, IMOR, rose from 3.06% in September 2025 to 3.34% in September 2026. Banks maintained good capitalisation levels, per El Economista.
why: Non-performing loan ratios signal credit quality, which drives provisions and profitability for lenders.
original_headline: Banca mantiene buenos niveles de capitalización al cierre del III Trim.
